sources.entry: DevDocs for macOS - An unofficial DevDocs API documentation viewer.

summary.one_liner: An unofficial macOS desktop viewer for DevDocs API documentation, with tabs, a global shortcut, and URL-scheme scripting.
summary.what_it_does: The app is a macOS wrapper around the DevDocs API documentation site. It opens DevDocs in a window with tab support. It registers a customizable global shortcut (Option + Space by default) to bring up the app. It follows the macOS automatic dark/light appearance. It supports in-page search with Cmd + F. It also handles the devdocs-macos:// URL scheme, so scripts can open a new window, or run a search for a term within a chosen documentation set. It can also open devdocs.io links in new windows.
use_cases: Read developer API docs in a dedicated macOS app
Look up a term across a specific documentation set from a script
Open a quick documentation search with a global hotkey
Keep several DevDocs pages open in tabs
Install the docs viewer via Homebrew
how_to_run: Or download a pre-built binary from the releases page, unzip, drag DevDocs.app to Applications, and run it
notable: Custom devdocs-macos:// URL scheme with search and newWindow commands, scriptable via osascript
Customizable global shortcut (Option + Space by default)
Tabbed windows with automatic dark/light mode
caveats: Unofficial client, not affiliated with DevDocs
Developed on Big Sur; only Big Sur support is offered. Mojave (10.14) and Catalina (10.15) users are directed to version 0.5.2
Links to devdocs.io are only opened in new windows for that domain; other domains are ignored
